name: Sha Tin
registryBasis: Hong Kong Lands Department and Land Registry provide local land/cadastral services; the Lands Department has a Sha Tin District Lands Office. The CSDI Lands Department Lot dataset is an official public Polygon Feature Layer (EPSG:2326) with safe identifiers OBJECTID, LotID, LotCSUID. A restricted exact-point query found no intersecting lot; a 200 m envelope returned one complete nearby polygon 52.02 m from the WUP point.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
scopeLimits: 3 valid distinct public parcel-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded paging, all 3 fresh native-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 20 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32650 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Source-native integer LotID is preserved unchanged; OBJECTID is used only for transport paging. The initial generic three-row pagination test could not exercise paging in these sparse cells and is retained separately; a fresh run forced one-row pages on a two-lot cell and reproduced both full geometries. Native source CRS is EPSG:2326 (ArcGIS WKID102140); requested EPSG:4326 output is unchanged. The exact point returned no lot; the original nearby full polygon matches fresh full geometry exactly. This is the CSDI Lot collection, separate from the existing private-lot index API. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term identity continuity remain unverified.
remainingUncertainty: Citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, survey accuracy and long-term native GIS identity continuity remain unverified.

officialSources.observation: Official Lands Department contact page lists the Sha Tin District Lands Office.
Official Land Registry explains its public IRIS land-record ordering and map-based lot/PRN lookup; this is a records service rather than the polygon source.
Official CSDI dataset “Lot,” provided by Lands Department and categorized as Land Parcel Framework spatial data.

Anonymous service/layer metadata GET returned HTTP 200. Polygon layer in EPSG:2326; fields: OBJECTID (OID), Shape__Length/Area, LotID (integer), LotCSUID (string). Query return fields were restricted to OBJECTID,LotID,LotCSUID.

Official LandsD map-service notice describes displayed parcel polygons as approximate-location aids, not legal boundary indications; this is an accuracy caveat, not a blocker to recording sample geometry.
